name: Ramsli
description: Ramsli is a Hungarian trick-taking game related to French Rams and Croatian Raub. 4-card hands. Donauschwaben (German Danube settlers) version documented by Rick Heli. Declarer vs defenders; bidding; trump.

overview.description: Ramsli is a Hungarian trick-taking game related to French Rams and Croatian Raub. 4-card hands. Donauschwaben (German Danube settlers) version documented by Rick Heli. Declarer vs defenders; bidding; trump.

history.origins: Hungarian Rams. Donauschwaben 18th-19th c. Rick Heli Card Games of Donauschwaben.

setup.deck: A 32-card pack with French suits and ranks from 7 to Ace, as used in the Rams group; one card is turned for trump.

rules.objective: Declarer makes bid; defenders try to prevent. Rams-style trick play.
rules.gameplay: As Rams/Raub: deal 4 each, turn trump, bidding, declarer vs defenders, play 4 tricks. See Rick Heli Donauschwaben for full rules.

tips: See Rick Heli for Donauschwaben rules.

variations.name: Donauschwaben
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Donauschwaben variant documented on Rick Heli site; engine overrides not yet mapped.

synthesis.shortDescription: Hungarian Rams. 4 cards. Related to Raub.
